card.title: Sr. Manager, Healthcare Quality Assurance
card.description:
We are currently looking for a Full Time Sr. Manager, Healthcare Quality Assurance to join our Healthcare Quality Assurance team located at the Newcastle Medical Center working 8:00AM-5:00PM - Mo Tu We Th Fr.

**Summary:** 
The Sr. Manager, Healthcare Quality Assurance is responsible for evaluating healthcare facilities, clinical operations, equipment, and support services to ensure compliance with federal, state, accreditation, and organizational standards. This position will conduct inspections, audits, investigations, and quality assessments to improve patient safety, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and healthcare outcomes. The role works closely with clinical leadership, facilities management, infection prevention, biomedical engineering, environment of care, and regulatory agencies to identify deficiencies and implement corrective actions.

**Responsibilities:** 

* Conducts comprehensive inspections and quality assurance audits of healthcare facilities, departments, and operations
* Evaluates compliance with standards established by organizations such as: The Joint Commission, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid, OSHA, NFPA, and FGI
* Inspects patient care areas, utility systems, medical equipment, life safety systems, infection control practices, and environmental conditions
* Reviews policies, procedures, maintenance records, inspection reports, and regulatory documentation
* Identifies deficiencies, risks, and non-compliance issues and prepares detailed corrective action recommendations
* Leads or assists with mock surveys, accreditation readiness activities, and regulatory inspections
* Monitors performance improvement initiatives and verifies corrective actions are completed effectively
* Prepares detailed written reports, inspection summaries, and compliance documentation
* Provides guidance and training to staff regarding healthcare regulations, safety standards, and quality improvement practices
* Maintains current knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and industry best practices
* Assists leadership in continuous quality improvement and patient safety initiatives
* Performs all other duties as assigned

**Competencies:** 
Essential:
 

* Ability to prepare clear and concise role-specific reports
* Ability to read, understand and interpret architectural, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, civil and structural drawings
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and general building construction trades
* Knowledge of international fire codes (IFC), international building codes (IBC), electrical codes (NEC), and international plumbing codes (IPC)
* Knowledge of infection control procedures
* Knowledge of all applicable regulatory and accrediting agency requirements
* Problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail
* Organizational and time-management abilities

**Skills:** 
Essential:
 

* Basic Computer skills
* Must be familiar with the Microsoft Office Suite of products
* Advanced project management skills
* Proficient in compliance tracking software and building automation systems

**Experience:** 
Essential:
 

* 3 years directly related supervisory experience
* 10 years directly related experience

**Education:** 
Essential:
 

* High School, GED or Equivalent

**Credentials:** 
Essential:
 

* CN Core Leadership Level 2
* Pass general background check
* Standard Driver's License
* Building Inspection Certification
* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional

 
 
Essential:
 

* This position requires completion of level two Core Leadership Training within 18 months of the hire or promotion date
* Ability to obtain Building Inspection Certification within 6 months of hire date

**Working Conditions:** 
Essential:
 

* Works in a hospital or clinic environment
* Frequently lift and or carry up to 25 lbs
* Sometimes lift and or carry up to 50 lbs
* Subject to traveling and working at other locations or in other environments
* May be required to work after hours or on weekends as needed
* Pass pre-employment drug test

**Training** 

* It is the responsibility of each employee to attend required training for their position or profession as determined by their line of support (LOS) or the leadership of the Chickasaw Nation. It is the responsibility of those who supervise, manage or otherwise lead employees or teams to ensure each employee has access to and receives all required training.

**Mission, Vision & Core Values** 
**Mission:** 

* To enhance the overall quality of life of the Chickasaw people.

**Vision:** 

* To be a nation of successful and united people with a strong cultural identity.

**Core Values:** 

* The Chickasaw People
* Cultural Identity
* Servant Leadership
* Selflessness
* Can Do Attitude
* Perseverance
* Stewardship
* Trust and Respect
* Loyalty
* Honesty and Integrity
* Teamwork

card.title: Construction Quality Control Director
card.description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

 

**Ferrovial Construction** is internationally recognized for its capacity to design and build civil engineering and construction projects, mainly in large transportation infrastructure. Its track-record to date includes more than 304 miles of tunnels, 11,930 miles of roads (including 2,485 miles of highways), 2920 miles of railroad lines (including 434 miles of high-speed railroads) and 16,994 miles of road maintenance and repair.

 

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

 

**Job Description:**
====================

**Overview:**

The Construction Quality Control Director is responsible for directing and managing the construction quality control program for major transportation and civil infrastructure projects. This position provides leadership and oversight for quality management systems, quality control activities, inspections, audits, documentation, nonconformance management, corrective actions, training, subcontractor quality requirements, and compliance with contract documents, project quality plans, federal, state, local, ISO 9001, and other applicable standards and requirements.

 

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

 

**Quality Management System Leadership**

* Direct, develop, implement, administer, and maintain the Construction Quality Management System for the project, including the Project Quality Management Plan.
* Provide leadership and oversight for project quality control activities, quality processes, quality documentation, and quality performance expectations.
* Establish and enforce controlled systems that safeguard the integrity of project plans, construction operations, quality records, and compliant project execution.
* Ensure quality management activities are aligned with contract documents, company requirements, project requirements, and applicable quality standards.
Establish quality objectives, key performance indicators, and metrics; manage the quality control budget and resource plan; and report quality performance to executive and project leadership. 

 

**Field Quality Control, Inspections, and Audits**

* Oversee field quality control activities, inspections, testing documentation, quality reports, audits, and related quality records.
* Verify and oversee that construction site activities are performed in accordance with applicable codes, standards, specifications, contract documents, and project quality requirements.
* Hold authority to reject nonconforming work and to issue hold-point or stop-work decisions when quality, safety, or contract requirements are not met, independent of production pressures.
* Develop and implement quality trainings and perform quality control audits for the project, subcontractors, and related project teams.
* Oversee materials testing programs and coordinate with certified testing laboratories and third-party inspectors.
Lead quality-related meetings with project teams, the owner, and subcontractors, and provide direction, follow-up, and technical support as needed. 

 

**Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with contract documents, the Project Quality Management Plan, and federal, state, local, ISO 9001, and other applicable regulatory laws and standards.
* Maintain and report quality management system records as required by the Project Quality Management Plan and company corporate requirements.  Oversee the preparation, review, and audit of quality reports, quality records, audit results, inspection documentation, test results, and other quality performance information.
* Ensure relevant quality control documentation is distributed to site subcontractors, project teams, and other stakeholders.
Serve as the primary quality liaison with the owner, GDOT and agency representatives, and thirdparty inspectors, including audit findings, work acceptance, and final quality closeout and turnover documentation. 

 

**Nonconformance, Corrective Actions, and Subcontractor Quality Support**

* Direct project-level nonconformance management and lead root cause analysis, corrective actions, and preventive actions through closure.
* Jointly with construction and procurement departments, review contractual specifications for materials to be used on the project.
* Oversee evaluations of consultants and subcontractors as specified in the Project Quality Management Plan, and hold them accountable to project quality requirements.
Provide technical recommendations and practical solutions to support quality compliance, issue resolution, lessons learned, and continuous improvement throughout construction. 

 

**Leadership, Safety, and Team Support**

* Lead, staff, mentor, and evaluate quality control managers, inspectors, and technicians, setting performance expectations and developing their technical skills.
* Provide leadership to quality teams, construction teams, subcontractors, consultants, and project stakeholders through example, direction, coordination, and sharing of knowledge and skills.  Partner with project leadership, construction, procurement, engineering, document control, safety, and other departments to ensure quality needs are being met.
* Demonstrate strong leadership, communication, technical judgment, integrity, ethics, safety awareness, attention to detail, and commitment to high standards.
Other unlisted duties will be assigned. 

 

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Science, Construction Management, Engineering, or related field required; Professional Engineer license required.
* Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive quality control management experience in construction or similar roles required, including supervision of quality control managers, inspectors, and technicians, preferably on large highway, bridge, paving, utility relocation, heavy civil, transportation, or related infrastructure projects.
* Experience developing and maintaining project quality management plans, quality systems, audits, inspections, reports, documentation, and corrective action processes required.
* Knowledge of construction quality control requirements, contract documents, specifications, drawings, ISO 9001, regulatory standards, testing, inspections, and documentation practices required.
* Experience managing quality control budgets and resources and working directly with owners, GDOT and agency representatives, and third-party inspectors and testing laboratories required.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, SharePoint, and document control systems; applicable quality and construction certifications preferred.
Strong ability to interpret construction documents and project records, with effective communication, reporting, leadership, organization, problem-solving, decision-making, attention to detail, safety, compliance, integrity, and ethics. 

 
 

*Note: The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and levels of work performed by employees, but are not a complete list of responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the employer.*

 
 

Ferrovial Construction-Webber 285 JV provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, national origin, age, disability, or status as a Vietnam Era or special disabled veteran in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. Ferrovial complies with applicable local, state and federal laws governing nondiscrimination in employment at each location the Company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

 

**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “ Protected Class ” ), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

**#WeAreFerrovial**

card.title: Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center (Onsite)
card.description:
Date Posted: 
2026-11-05

 Country: 
United States of America

 Location: 
US-GA-MIDLAND-MPC ~ 8801/8987 Macon Rd ~ BLDG MPC

 Position Role Type: 
Onsite

 U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements: 
U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract.

 Security Clearance Type: 
None/Not Required

 Security Clearance Status: 
Not Required 
 
 At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. 

 Pratt & Whitne y is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
 Quality Director, Columbus Engine Center

 What You Will Do: 
 As the Quality Director for the Columbus Engine Center, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring a "quality-first" culture within a large, dynamic organization. You will lead strategic initiatives to enhance product safety, compliance, and operational excellence, while fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include:
 Providing strategic leadership for all Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and inspection activities across the Columbus Engine Center.
 Collaborating with Operations, Engineering, and Materials teams to ensure robust processes, effective change management, and prevention-based quality measures.
 Championing product safety through operational discipline and continuous improvement on the shop floor.
 Overseeing critical compliance programs, including training, records management, audits (internal, regulator, and customer), procedures, and major investigations.
 Monitoring and reporting on key quality metrics, developing action plans to achieve organizational goals.
 Ensuring adherence to AS9100, FAA, DCMA, and customer-specific quality requirements.
 Leading root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives using CORE tools.
 Driving process capability improvements, defect reduction, and first-pass yield enhancements through data-driven decision-making.
 Managing nonconforming material, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and risk assessments for critical aerospace components.
 
 Qualifications You Must Have :
 Bachelor’s degree and 14 years of experience, or 12 years of experience with an Advanced degree.
 Experience in Quality Management within the Aerospace or other highly regulated manufacturing industry.
 Senior leadership or people management experience.
 Experience in Operations, Quality, or Engineering within the Aerospace manufacturing industry.
 
 Qualifications We Prefer :
 5+ years of experience in Operations Leadership.
 Experience leading organizations and other leaders.
 Aftermarket Aerospace / Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience.
 Familiarity with FAR-145 / CFR-145 Repair Station operations.
 Knowledge of FAA regulatory compliance.
 Background in Engineering.
 Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Certification.
 Experience with SAP Quality systems.
 Understanding of AS9100 and Quality Management Systems (QMS).
 
 Learn More & Apply Now!
 Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
 This position is considered safety sensitive in accordance with FAA Guidelines. Candidate will be subject to drug and alcohol testing per FAA's regulation 14 CFR part 120, as well as 49 CFR part 40.
 Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:
 Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
 
 
 As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

card.title: Director of Risk Management and Quality
card.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

**Your experience matters**

At Westpark Springs, we are committed to empowering and supporting a diverse and determined workforce who can drive quality, scalability, and significant impact across our hospitals and communities. In your role, you'll support those that are in our facilities who are interfacing and providing care to our patients and community members. We believe that our collective efforts will shape a healthier future for the communities we serve.

**What we offer**

Fundamental to providing great care is supporting and rewarding our team. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* Health (Medical, Dental, Vision) and 401K Benefits for full-time employees
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program - mental, physical, and financial wellness assistance
* Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance for qualified applicants
* And much more...

**About Us**

**People are our passion and purpose.** Westpark Springs is a 96 bed hospital located in Richmond, TX and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone-your experience matters.

**How you'll contribute:**

Leads and oversees a comprehensive, efficient, and integrated hospital-wide Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement (CQPI) program. Uses data collection, analysis, and trending to assess performance; focuses on process and systems improvement; directs risk management and patient safety activities; investigates adverse outcomes; coordinates regulatory/accreditation readiness; and educates staff on CQPI and related quality programs. **This role is 100% onsite.**

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Licensure:** Registered Nurse with current state licensure highly preferred; clinical license required.

**Education:** BSN or BS/BA required.

**Experience:** Minimum two (2) years in an acute hospital or rehabilitation setting required; prior supervisory experience preferred.

**Certifications:** Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) required; certification preferred by APIC (American Practitioners of Infection Control) and NAHCQ (National Association of Health Care Quality).

**Skills:** Data analysis and reporting; CQPI methodologies (e.g., RCA, FMEA, PDSA); risk management and patient safety facilitation; regulatory/accreditation readiness; effective teaching, communication, and collaboration.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Job Specific:**

* Provides leadership and oversight of a comprehensive, efficient and integrated organization wide Continuous Quality Performance Improvement program.
* Measures and assesses performance through collection, analyses, and trending of data.
* Focuses on processes and systems to improve performance.
* Directs, facilitates, and reports on all aspects of services relating to risk management and patient safety.
* Investigates factors contributing to adverse outcomes in order to improve processes and systems.
* Encourages reporting on risk reduction strategies in an atmosphere which minimizes blame or retaliation. Fosters environment to reduce unanticipated adverse events and/or outcomes.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement and additional hospital-wide education and training.
* Directs the functions and operation of the hospital-wide continuous quality improvement program including review of records for indicators of quality; reports findings to leadership, Medical Executive Committee, the Board of Managers and other committees as appropriate.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement to hospital and medical staff.
* Annually reviews hospital wide plans for the functions of IC and CQPI and establishes goals and objectives for the next year.
* Acts as a liaison to local health officials, coordinates inspections and accreditation reviews with state and other regulatory agencies.
* Demonstrates knowledge of growth, development, and the aging process for the planning and delivery of age-appropriate care.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Skills:**

* Basic computer knowledge.
* Knowledge of basic equipment.
* Appropriate telephone communication skills.

OSHA EXPOSURE DETERMINATION:

* A key element for a successful Exposure Control Plan is to identify situations that place all employees at risk for exposure. To facilitate this, the Hospital maintains a list of job classifications and contact status for all employees in which employees have occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens. This position has been identified as Category III: Employees who have no occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens in the normal performance of job duties.

**EEOC Statement:**

Westpark Springs is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities for all applicants and employees and complies with all applicable laws prohibiting discrimination against any employee or applicant for employment because of color, race, sex, age, religion, national origin, disability, genetic

Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.

 
We employ and provide care to people from all walks of life. We are committed to promoting healing, providing hope, preserving dignity and producing value with an inclusive workforce in which diversity is leveraged, respected, and reflective of the patients, family members, customers and team members we serve.Lifepoint Health is a leader in community-based care and driven by a mission of Making Communities Healthier. Our diversified healthcare delivery network spans 29 states and includes 63 community hospital campuses, 32 rehabilitation and behavioral health hospitals, and more than 170 additional sites of care across the healthcare continuum, such as acute rehabilitation units, outpatient centers and post-acute care facilities. We believe that success is achieved through talented people. We want to create places where employees want to work, with opportunities to pursue meaningful and satisfying careers that truly make a difference in communities across the country.

card.title: Director of Risk Management and Quality
card.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

**Your experience matters**

At Westpark Springs, we are committed to empowering and supporting a diverse and determined workforce who can drive quality, scalability, and significant impact across our hospitals and communities. In your role, you'll support those that are in our facilities who are interfacing and providing care to our patients and community members. We believe that our collective efforts will shape a healthier future for the communities we serve.

**What we offer**

Fundamental to providing great care is supporting and rewarding our team. In addition to your base compensation, this position also offers:

* Health (Medical, Dental, Vision) and 401K Benefits for full-time employees
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Employee Assistance Program - mental, physical, and financial wellness assistance
* Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance for qualified applicants
* And much more...

**About Us**

**People are our passion and purpose.** Westpark Springs is a 96 bed hospital located in Richmond, TX and is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network committed to making communities healthier® with acute care, rehabilitation, and behavioral health facilities from coast to coast. From your first day to your next career milestone-your experience matters.

**How you'll contribute:**

Leads and oversees a comprehensive, efficient, and integrated hospital-wide Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement (CQPI) program. Uses data collection, analysis, and trending to assess performance; focuses on process and systems improvement; directs risk management and patient safety activities; investigates adverse outcomes; coordinates regulatory/accreditation readiness; and educates staff on CQPI and related quality programs. **This role is 100% onsite.**

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Licensure:** Registered Nurse with current state licensure highly preferred; clinical license required.

**Education:** BSN or BS/BA required.

**Experience:** Minimum two (2) years in an acute hospital or rehabilitation setting required; prior supervisory experience preferred.

**Certifications:** Basic Life Support (BLS/CPR) required; certification preferred by APIC (American Practitioners of Infection Control) and NAHCQ (National Association of Health Care Quality).

**Skills:** Data analysis and reporting; CQPI methodologies (e.g., RCA, FMEA, PDSA); risk management and patient safety facilitation; regulatory/accreditation readiness; effective teaching, communication, and collaboration.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Job Specific:**

* Provides leadership and oversight of a comprehensive, efficient and integrated organization wide Continuous Quality Performance Improvement program.
* Measures and assesses performance through collection, analyses, and trending of data.
* Focuses on processes and systems to improve performance.
* Directs, facilitates, and reports on all aspects of services relating to risk management and patient safety.
* Investigates factors contributing to adverse outcomes in order to improve processes and systems.
* Encourages reporting on risk reduction strategies in an atmosphere which minimizes blame or retaliation. Fosters environment to reduce unanticipated adverse events and/or outcomes.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement and additional hospital-wide education and training.
* Directs the functions and operation of the hospital-wide continuous quality improvement program including review of records for indicators of quality; reports findings to leadership, Medical Executive Committee, the Board of Managers and other committees as appropriate.
* Responsible for education of Continuous Quality and Performance Improvement to hospital and medical staff.
* Annually reviews hospital wide plans for the functions of IC and CQPI and establishes goals and objectives for the next year.
* Acts as a liaison to local health officials, coordinates inspections and accreditation reviews with state and other regulatory agencies.
* Demonstrates knowledge of growth, development, and the aging process for the planning and delivery of age-appropriate care.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Skills:**

* Basic computer knowledge.
* Knowledge of basic equipment.
* Appropriate telephone communication skills.

OSHA EXPOSURE DETERMINATION:

* A key element for a successful Exposure Control Plan is to identify situations that place all employees at risk for exposure. To facilitate this, the Hospital maintains a list of job classifications and contact status for all employees in which employees have occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens. This position has been identified as Category III: Employees who have no occupational exposure to bloodborne pathogens in the normal performance of job duties.

**EEOC Statement:**
